fixes.explanation: Right, baker. The teacher says, “Wisdom is too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the meeting place.” So at that meeting, the fool isn't the one talking. Wisdom is out of his reach, so he stays quiet. That's why False is the answer.

Yes, friend. The teacher imagines someone saying they didn't know about this, and then he asks, “Does not the One who guards your life know?” He also asks whether He who weighs hearts considers it (Proverbs 24:12). So the question points to the One who guards your life. Nobody gets to say they didn't know.
